title: Assistant Finance Manager
description:
Position Executive to Asstt. Manager– Finance Experience - Minimum 10 Years of Relevant Experience Qualification CA Inter / M.Com / PGDFA Candidates with relevant professional qualifications and strong practical exposure in Finance may also be considered. Job Location – GIDA Gorakhpur Compensation - Negotiable – Based on Candidate's Experience, Competency & Current CTC Key Responsibilities 1. Fund Raising & Financial Arrangement Manage and coordinate the company's fund-raising activities through banks and financial institutions. Evaluate various sources of finance including working capital, term loans, structured finance and other debt facilities. Prepare proposals, financial information and supporting documents for fund raising. Coordinate with lenders, financial institutions and internal stakeholders for timely sanction and disbursement of funds. Monitor utilization of sanctioned limits and ensure compliance with financing terms and conditions. 2. Banking Coordination Manage day-to-day banking relationships and coordinate with banks for various financial requirements. Handle working capital limits, bank guarantees, letters of credit, fund-based and non-fund-based facilities. Coordinate with banks for enhancement, renewal and restructuring of banking facilities. Ensure timely submission of financial statements, stock statements, CMA data and other documents required by banks. Maintain effective relationships with bankers and financial institutions. 3. CMA Data & Financial Reporting Preparation and submission of CMA Data for working capital and other banking requirements. Prepare projected financial statements, cash-flow projections and fund-flow statements. Analyze financial performance and working capital requirements. Provide financial data and MIS reports to management for decision-making. Monitor actual performance against projections and highlight significant variances. 4. Financial Modelling & Business Analysis Develop and maintain financial models for business planning, fund raising and investment decisions. Prepare financial projections, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis and feasibility studies. Analyze project/business proposals from financial and commercial perspectives. Support management in evaluating new projects, expansion plans and strategic initiatives. Prepare management presentations and financial analysis as required. 5. Treasury Management Manage daily cash-flow planning and treasury operations. Monitor cash inflows and outflows and ensure optimum utilization of available funds. Plan short-term funding requirements and ensure adequate liquidity. Monitor interest costs, borrowing costs and financing arrangements. Coordinate with banks for fund transfers, payments and other treasury-related activities. Optimize working capital and minimize idle funds and financial costs. 6. Budgeting & Financial Planning Assist in preparation of annual budgets and financial plans. Monitor budget versus actual performance and analyze variances. Coordinate with various departments for budget preparation and periodic revisions. Provide financial inputs for strategic and operational decision-making. 7. SAP & Finance Operations Working knowledge of SAP Finance / Accounting modules . Review and monitor financial transactions and reports through SAP. Coordinate with accounts and other departments for accurate and timely financial accounting. Ensure proper documentation and adherence to financial controls and company policies. Key Skills & Competencies Strong experience in Fund Raising & Debt Financing Excellent Banking & Financial Institution Coordination Hands-on experience in CMA Data Preparation Strong Financial Modelling & Financial Analysis skills Sound knowledge of Treasury & Cash Flow Management Working knowledge of SAP Strong understanding of Working Capital Management

Key Skills: Fund Raising,Fund Management,Project Funding,Project Financing,Information Memorandum,Credit Rating,Treasury,Term Loan
